name: callout
title: Callout
description: Inline message with a tone (info, success, warning, danger, ai). Icon plus text, never color alone.

a11y.pattern: Static block; role="status" or role="alert" only when live is set
aria: Tone is conveyed by icon and title text, not by color
live="polite" renders role="status"; live="assertive" renders role="alert"
Use live only for messages that appear after load; static page notes need no live role
The ai tone uses the spark icon and the default title "Generated by AI, review needed"
a11y.notes: Never nest actions that duplicate the page primary action. Actions are real buttons or links passed in the actions slot.
